verdict_summary.NEXT_ACTION: Preserve experimental capture disabled by default. Formalize finding that on MediaTek OEM ROMs with active DuraSpeed, in-process isolated WebViews are suppressed by the OS for non-whitelisted apps unless global setting.duraspeed.enabled is set to 0. Recommend proceeding with backend direct acquisition for general device compatibility.
